parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstanceList](~~118698~~) operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances.

parameters.name: Ip
parameters.description: The protected IP address to query.

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: ProductName
parameters.description:
The type of the cloud asset to which the protected IP address to query belongs. Valid values:

*   **ECS**: an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance.
*   **SLB**: a Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance, originally called a Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance.
*   **EIP**: an elastic IP address (EIP). An Internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB) instance uses an EIP. If the IP address belongs to the Internet-facing ALB instance, set this parameter to EIP.
*   **WAF**: a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the Anti-DDoS Origin instance resides.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~118703~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddosbgp describe-pack-ip-list --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --instance-id ddosbgp-cn-n6w1r7nz0000 --ip 47.98.XX.XX --product-name ECS --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --member-uid 1708588696790000 --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
